name: Picture motion
responsibility: Turns one scene into the next as one Between, made by a carry or an entrance and sampled by progress: it pairs groups by subject id and mixes their typed geometry, opacity and transforms
description: Twelve names, all on one Between (ADR 0087): carry(from, to, shift, phases) carries the last picture into the next, and enter(to, phases, handover) brings a picture in part by part and, when subjects fly over, answers the last picture's body without them for its ghost. at(progress) answers the in-between body and the masks of the lines that move, and definitions() answers the carry's definitions apart, so the move keeps no state between samples (ADR 0071). seen_at, focus, holder_at and rebase answer the rest; departing sends the last scene off, and frame_of finds a subject's frame. The kind stays private: a carry ignores rebase and answers no holder, flown subjects or tray, and an entrance moves no mask and opens no door. Nothing here draws or reads a clock, and the phases come from @archboard/timing through the page. The stage's Arriving (flight.rs) owns the time, turning a moment into progress, and keeps the definitions index; the dive samples the move by the camera's path. phase lives in timing.rs and Heading beside the passage's Side, so the passage and Picture motion no longer import each other.
